name: Wyoming

rule.textEn: Wyoming has no mandatory boater education. Operators of a registered motorboat or PWC must be 16, or younger with an adult 18+ aboard.
rule.textEs: Wyoming no exige educación náutica obligatoria. Quien maneje una lancha registrada o una moto acuática debe tener 16 años, o menos si va a bordo un adulto de 18 años o más.

minAge.note: Under 16 may operate a motorboat or PWC only with an adult 18+ physically aboard and responsible. No age limit for non-motorized craft.

card.feeNote: Game and Fish gives a free Boat America home-study packet and exam; the online courses are free to take but charge $29.95 for the exam and card.

pwcExtra: Same age rule as motorboats: 16, or younger with an adult 18+ aboard.

sources.quote: Possessing a boating safety certificate card is required by some states - but not in Wyoming - in order to operate motorboats
The Wyoming Game and Fish Department offers a free “Boat America” home study course packet and exam
These courses are free to take but require a $29.95 examination and certificate printing fee.

To legally operate a motorboat, the operator must be at least 16 years old. A person under the age of 16 may operate a motorboat as long as they are accompanied by an adult who is at least 18 years old.

sources.publisher: Wyoming Game and Fish Department, 2023 Wyoming Watercraft Regulation
sources.quote: by a person under sixteen (16) years of age who is not accompanied by an adult. (This includes personal watercraft, i.e., jet skis.)
There is no age restriction to operate a non-motorized watercraft, like a canoe, kayak or raft.
